title: Hearty Italian Onion Frittata
description: A classic Italian-style omelette packed with caramelized onions and a touch of British charm.
instructions: In a large skillet, cook the minced garlic over low heat until fragrant.
Add the caramelized onion and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and grated cheddar.
Season the egg mixture with salt to taste.
Pour the egg mixture over the onion mixture in the skillet.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the eggs are set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the frittata hot, sliced into wedges.
